explanation: $\begin{aligned} & m=\frac{m_0}{\sqrt{1-\frac{v^2}{c^2}}} \\ & \text { বেগ} \mathrm{v}=\frac{\mathrm{c}}{\sqrt{2}} \text { বা, } m=\frac{m_0}{\sqrt{1-\left(\frac{\frac{c}{\sqrt{2}}}{c}\right)^2}} \\ & \text { বা, } \mathrm{m}=\frac{\mathrm{m}_0}{\sqrt{1-\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)^2}} \text { বা, } \mathrm{m}=\sqrt{2} \mathrm{~m}_0 \\ & \text { ভরবেগ, } \mathrm{P}=\sqrt{2} \mathrm{~m}_0 \times \frac{\mathrm{c}}{\sqrt{2}}=m_0 c\end{aligned}$
